Camp Bronze Lake is the complete aetheryte destination and is explicitly protected by the glossary. The Bronze Lake override applies to the lake itself.

Le proprie ali uses the possessive agreeing with ali. Chi can refer to either player gender, so the gender selection is redundant; the player name macro remains intact.

Ruby Weapon identifies BNpcName9250 and remains English under the explicit enemy-name exception. Riuscita or riuscito correctly follows player gender.

Ruby Weapon is the complete named enemy BNpcName9250. The narrative family term Arma does not replace part of this exact enemy name.
Diamond Weapon is the complete named enemy BNpcName9953. The glossary explicitly preserves enemy labels; dalla is grammatical with implicit macchina or Arma.
Hall of the Radiant Host is the complete PlaceName3870 and4009 destination. Neither the military-force override nor the member adjective requires replacing a substring of this location label.

Walker's popotoes identifies the protected Item17946 material, not an Echo bearer. The Walker override is scoped to StmBda601. Wild and mountain popotoes likewise name stock materials; no binding rule requires altering their original plurals.
The sister wore a rabbit costume at the celebration; FR costume de lapin and JA rabbit disguise support a descriptive clothing noun. This is not an inventory label or instruction to equip Item30045.

The merchant offers packets of Snack degli Angeli, the explicit glossary narrative rendering of Angel Snacks. The offer, current popularity and Solution Nine destination are intact; the present target satisfies the glossary.
Hall of the Unbound is the complete PlaceName4755 room that the player cannot reenter. The Unbound override is scoped to the short name for Porta dei Liberi, not this exact hall label.
The source describes a giant pumpkin-headed doll, not the ingredient Giant Pumpkin. Enorme modifies pupazzo and testa di zucca preserves the doll appearance.
Archons' Design is the complete PlaceName3809 meeting destination. It is not a reference to a person holding the Archon title.

The speaker describes regional orange juice as a refreshing beverage; FR jus d orange nosceenne and JA orange juice support food prose. Succo di arance di La Noscea is not an inventory or ingredient selector label.

Saint of Nymeia is the full named persona, also shown as the French speaker name. The Saint override explicitly applies only to the abbreviated title and must not replace a substring of this complete NPC name.

Sea of Clouds is the Heavensward zone, retained in English by the explicit glossary exception. The translated common nouns preserve the contrast between sea among clouds and the named zone.
